responsibility: Implements the V850 port’s C-family frontend glue for target-specific pragmas, especially the Green Hills compatible #pragma ghs forms. It parses section-mapping pragmas and the start/end small-data-area pragmas, maintains the nested data-area stack shared with the backend, updates the current section-name aliases used for data placement, and applies the V850-specific interrupt function attribute to the current declaration, issuing pragma diagnostics for malformed or mismatched directives.
